ticket.title: The fill prompt does not tell the model which crates the scratch crate depends on
ticket.description:
Observed immediately after GB-217 step 4 removed the transport failure: the Gold-path fill now returns a candidate that imports unicode_segmentation, which /tmp/gb-gold-crate does not depend on, so verification fails with "compile: unresolved import unicode_segmentation" and HoleFillFailed. The model is not wrong to reach for that crate - counting graphemes in Rust usually does use it - but the prompt never says what is available, so every retry makes the same mistake and no rejected_attempt becomes a repaired Gold pair.

TWO FIXES, both cheap: (1) include the scratch crate declared dependencies in the prompt, or (2) add common dependencies to the fixture crate so a reasonable solution compiles. Either way the assertion is the same: a fill of grapheme_count against a crate that can express it produces tier gold rather than HoleFillFailed. This is the last known blocker between a working transport and a non-empty DPO shard.
